## About
L & E Tires Services is a tire shop on Jensen Drive in Houston, also known as L & E Auto Whole Parts. We keep both new and used tires and rims in stock, so you can pick what fits your car and your budget.
We know a set of tires or a repair bill can come at a bad time. That's why we offer loans and payment plans for tires and auto repair expenses, with approvals for good to bad credit.
We're open Monday through Saturday and hold a 4.3 rating from 34 Google reviews. Stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- New and used tires and rims: We stock both new and used tires, plus rims, so you have options at different price points.
- Payment plans for tires and auto repair: Loans and payment plans to help you cover the cost of tires and auto repair expenses.
- Running board installation: One reviewer had running boards installed on a Dodge Ram here and recommended us for running board installation.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need good credit to get a payment plan?
A: No. We approve customers with good to bad credit, and you can apply for instant credit.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes on Saturday, from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: If a reply is needed, you'll hear back within 48 to 72 hours. For anything sooner, give us a call.
